name: 33428 · Boca Raton, FL
findings: ZIP 33428 (Boca Raton) has 128 nonprofit organizations. 36 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (34% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33428 (Boca Raton) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33428 (Boca Raton) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 46% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 35 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
